facts.material: gold-plated base metal implements; leather zip-top case
facts.function: personal grooming/toilet (tweezers, nail clippers, safety scissors, pen knife, shoe horn)
facts.form: set of different implements put up together in a fitted leather case for retail sale

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9605 covers travel sets for personal toilet, sewing or shoe or clothes cleaning, other than manicure and pedicure sets of 8214
The set is not limited to manicure/pedicure instruments (it includes a pen knife and a shoe horn), so it is not a manicure set of 8214.20 and falls in 9605 eo nomine
GRI 5(a): the fitted leather case is classified with the set

rejected_alternatives.reason: manicure or pedicure sets in leather containers; the set also contains a shoe horn and pen knife, so it is more than a manicure set
the leather case is a GRI 5(a) container classified with its contents
pen knife alone; the set is classified as a whole under heading 9605

classification.rationale: The article is a toilet set in a fitted leather case. Its implements go beyond manicure and pedicure instruments (a shoe horn and a pen knife are included), so it is a travel set for personal toilet of heading 9605 rather than a manicure set of 8214. NY H83408 (in force) classified a leather-cased travel grooming set containing a shoe horn and nail accessories in 9605.00.0000, and a pure manicure set in 8214.20.6000. The leather case follows the set under GRI 5(a).
